privacy.ai_training_note: For the Corporate product: vendor claims 'your data remains your property: it is never used to train our models' (sourced from corporate-translation.reverso.com). For the consumer/free product: the privacy policy states 'When you are not logged in, no personal data is stored by Reverso. When you are logged in to Reverso Translation, Conjugation, or Spelling services, no personal data is collected.' An exception exists: Reverso retains 'an anonymized and sampled history of spelling errors corrected by its spelling checker, for the sole purpose of analyzing this data for statistical purposes and improving the services offered.' This is anonymized, not raw user content. Document uploads in Reverso Documents are stored temporarily and may be accessed by support only if the user requests help; users can delete at any time.
privacy.data_region: Europe (all personal data is hosted in Europe per the privacy policy; corporate product advertises 100% European hosting)

security.name: Data Residency
security.value: 100% European hosting; personal data hosted in Europe

security.name: Encryption / Technical Measures
security.value: Privacy policy states 'Reverso implements appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure the security and confidentiality of personal data.' No specific encryption standards (AES-256, TLS version) are cited in public documentation.

security.name: Bug Bounty Program
security.value: None found. No listing on HackerOne, Bugcrowd, or vendor website.
security.source: Web search conducted 2026-06-27; no results returned.

security.name: Cookie / Advertising Partners
security.value: Consumer site works with 1038 advertising/analytics partners for personalised advertising and audience measurement (IAB TCF consent model). Users can withdraw consent via Privacy Settings.

security.name: Subprocessors
security.value: Payment handled by Braintree, Google, Apple. Google Analytics used for audience measurement. Full subprocessor list not published.

security.name: On-Premise Deployment (Corporate)
security.value: Available for Corporate product: 'cloud or on-premise deployment depending on IT and security requirements'

products.name: Reverso Free / Web (reverso.net)
products.data_scope: No personal data stored for logged-out users. Logged-in users: search history and favorites stored for Context and Synonyms services; spell checker history retained in anonymized, sampled form for service improvement. No personal data collected for Translation, Conjugation, or Spelling when logged in.
products.notes: Ad-supported. Partnered with 1038 advertising/analytics vendors via IAB TCF. Not appropriate for confidential or enterprise content.

products.name: Reverso Premium
products.data_scope: Same data handling as free product for core services. Unlocks longer text translation, document translation (Word, PDF, PowerPoint), unlimited AI rephrase/correction. Payment processed by Braintree/Google/Apple.
products.notes: Individual tier only. No enterprise DPA or compliance documentation available at this tier.

products.name: Reverso Documents
products.data_scope: Uploaded files stored temporarily for online review; edits saved to personal translation memory. Users can delete at any time. Support accesses only on user request. Not shared publicly.
products.notes: Suitable for personal/professional individual use. No enterprise SLA or DPA at this tier.

products.name: Reverso Corporate Translator
products.category: Enterprise AI translation and writing platform
products.data_scope: ISO 27001 certified, SecNumCloud qualified, 100% European hosting. Data explicitly not used for model training. Supports API, intranet, CRM/CSM/web integrations, and on-premise deployment.
products.notes: Purpose-built for enterprise confidentiality requirements. DPA availability not confirmed on public page; requires direct contact with sales (+33 1 41 43 10 38). SOC2 status unconfirmed from vendor's own domain.

products.name: Reverso Apps (Mac/Windows/iOS/Android/Chrome/Edge)
products.data_scope: Real-time translation integrated across apps, chats, emails, articles, documents. Same privacy policy as reverso.net applies.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free consumer tier) + Reverso Premium (paid subscription) + Reverso Corporate (custom enterprise pricing, contact sales)
compare.data_residency: Europe (100% European hosting for all products per corporate page and privacy policy)
